chapter_theme: The way of the true guru (சற்குரு நெறி): the true guru gives his feet, makes one know oneself, lifts the soul beyond the tattvas and quells its bonds; like alchemy turning iron to gold for good, his grace ends birth. He shows the real, the unreal and the real-unreal, burns away the malas, and is finally the Supreme himself acting through the five acts.
structure_note: What the true guru gives (2049 to 2051), the true guru set against the false (2052, 2053), alchemical images (2051, 2054), the guru's path and teaching (2055 to 2058), the soul freed of the malas (2059, 2060), the Lord's play and five acts (2061 to 2063, 2065), nectar (2064), and a closing definition: the Supreme is the guru (2066).

2049.reading: The true guru is the lord who gives his feet and protects; giving his feet he can grant self-knowledge; giving his feet he brings the soul beyond the tattvas; giving his feet he quells the bonds: he is the Real.
2049.nuance: தாள்தந்து opens every line: the gift of the feet, a form of initiation, is the guru's single act with four effects. சத்து (the Real) in the last word makes the true guru (சற்குரு) one with the Real he shows.

2050.reading: He ended the deeds and the afflictions that seize his devotees; he set his feet upon their heads; he kept away the band of Yama's messengers; he ended the sorrow of birth.
2050.nuance: தவிரவைத்தான் (he made it cease) opens each line; in the second it seems to mean he placed the feet without fail, so the refrain bends in sense. கோள் may be the planets' evil influence or anything that seizes.

2051.reading: As black iron, once turned to gold, does not turn back into iron, so one who has received the guru's grace at the very moment marked will not come near birth again.
2051.nuance: The alchemical image stresses that the change is final. குறித்த அப்போதே, the appointed moment, may be the moment of initiation or the time ripe for grace.

2052.reading: Those who remove the bond, seek with love the Supreme and themselves, and drive out impurity completely are faultless true gurus; those who, lacking knowledge, are moved by clamour are not gurus who give understanding.
2052.nuance: பூசற்கு இரங்குவோர் is unclear: பூசல் is clamour or strife, so it may be teachers stirred by quarrels and show; a reading as பூசை (ritual worship) is possible. போதக் குரு is a guru who teaches understanding.

2053.reading: The stainless one who stands in love, able to give a love free of impurity, eternal and pure, is the lasting guru who gives to the loving ones who have grasped the tattvas as they are and are freed of them.
2053.nuance: நேயம் (love) repeats in three lines. The opening phrase matches Tiruvachakam, Sivapuranam 13 (நேயத்தே நின்ற நிமலன்), as Sengalvaraya notes. Line 3 (ஆயத்தவர் தத்துவம் உணர்ந்து ஆங்கு அற்ற) is compressed and my reading of it is tentative.

2054.reading: As everything the philosopher's stone touches becomes gold of rank, so all the world the guru touches is rid of the three malas and reaches the Siva-state.
2054.nuance: பரிசன வேதி is the stone that transmutes by touch; பரிசித்த (touched) ties the image to initiation by the guru's touch (ஸ்பர்ச தீக்ஷை in later manuals). திரிமலம் are traditionally anava, karma and maya.

2055.reading: When the presence of the true guru who stands as the very self, and that nature of being the self, are revealed, the self must win itself; to gain this, consider within you that the body is only flesh.
2055.nuance: தானே என நின்ற can be 'standing as oneself' or 'standing as He alone'. சதுர் may be skill or the fourth state (turiya). ஊனே என நினைந்து may be 'thinking it is mere flesh' or 'thinking of him as intimate as one's flesh'.

2056.reading: The path of coming and going, the path of maya, the path that those who saw the womb's path do not see, the great path Nandi speaks of: going by the guru's path one can reach it.
2056.nuance: வழி ends every half-line. The first two paths are birth and death under maya; the last two are the path of release, unseen by those who know only birth, and taught by Nandi. The guru's path joins them.

2057.reading: The guru is the one of supreme bliss whom the Veda and Agama describe, who practises Siva-yoga, has no thought of his own and removes the soul's bonds; one may place oneself with such a good guru when he comes.
2057.nuance: ஒருசிந்தையின்றி may mean 'without any other thought' or 'without a separate thought of his own'. வைக்கலும் ஆமே leaves unclear who is placed: the pupil entrusting himself, or the soul set with the guru.

2058.reading: Showing the real, the unreal and the real-unreal, setting the sentient and the insentient in Siva the Supreme, speaking the word that is bliss beyond pure and impure: when he speaks, he is the Father's grace-guru.
2058.nuance: சத்து, அசத்து and சதசத்து are traditionally the Lord, the bonds, and the soul that can turn to either; the verse lists them without assigning them. சித்து and அசித்து are the sentient and the insentient.

2059.reading: By bowing at the feet of the Lord who is free of attachment, those who wither the five malas that well up and the awareness of bondage, scorch the surrounding divisions by the three turiyas, and reach the Supreme are the true adepts.
2059.nuance: ஐம்மலம் are traditionally anava, karma, maya, mayeya and tirodhana. துரியம் மூன்று (three turiyas) is a technical term I can't fix; it may be the fourth state in the three avasthas of soul, Shakti and Siva. சாதகர் are practitioners who have reached the goal.

2060.reading: All is the Lord's bliss with the Lady; when the strong senses come, the soul appears; the five unspoken malas subside, and rising to reach the Siva-state that does not pass is play.
2060.nuance: விளையாட்டு (play) is read of the Lord: the soul's embodiment and release are his sport with the Lady. சொல்லா மலம் may be malas beyond words or ones not to be named. செல்லா may mean 'not passing away' or 'where none goes'.

2061.reading: Drawing back the soul he had placed in a lowly birth, setting it in its place and feeding it, humbling it, recovering it by knowledge, establishing it, and placing it in silence once it reaches release: these are the doings of the Freed One.
2061.nuance: The list may map onto the Lord's acts toward the soul, ending in grace. மீட்டுட்டி is obscure, perhaps மீட்டு ஊட்டி. முத்தன் (the Freed One) is the Lord, or the guru in whom he acts.

2062.reading: The insentient world is the playground of the Father's grace; the soul he has made discern the sentient from the insentient he makes pure, wipes away its mala and sets with the Real: such is the way of his five acts.
2062.nuance: சடம் (insentient matter) is not illusion here but the field where grace works. The five acts are presented as all serving the soul's purification.

2063.reading: Our stainless Lord, who stood in love for those who pass beyond the Isa tattva and say there is nothing beyond, and for those who, still in bondage, ever contemplate him, has made all the realms clear.
2063.nuance: ஈசத்துவம் is the Isvara tattva, one of the pure tattvas. The first two lines are obscure; பாவியும் may be 'contemplating' (பாவித்தல்) or 'even the sinner'.

2064.reading: In the mandala that rises blossoming like a garland of rubies, pure gold stood and nectar ripened there; those who guarded it and drank lived free of birth, and the brutes who did not perceive it lived for the flesh.
2064.nuance: The mandala, the rubies and the pure gold (ஆணிப்பொன்) are symbolic and taken in yogic readings as a region of the head where nectar forms. மாக்கள் (brutes) is the word for those who live only for the body.

2065.reading: So that the real with the unreal and the real-unreal are set apart and the clinging attachment of bondage is cut here, the Lord moves the two mayas and the soul there and makes the one thing known.
2065.nuance: இரு மாயை are traditionally pure and impure maya, and அணு is the bound soul. The syntax is hard and my reading is a guess.

2066.reading: Because he burns mala by the ascending path, cuts away darkness by the endless word and withers the soul's bond so that release comes, the Supreme himself, if you would name him, is the guru.
2066.nuance: The chapter ends by collapsing the distinction: the guru's three acts (burning, cutting, withering) are the Supreme's, so the true guru is the Supreme. ஈறில் உரை (the endless word) may be the teaching or the mantra.

links.note: Both define the Siva-guru by the same act, showing the real, the unreal and the real-unreal (சத்தும் அசத்தும் சதசத்தும்).

Both use transmutation by contact: whatever comes to the golden mountain takes its colour (1511), whatever the philosopher's stone touches becomes gold (2054); both make the guru's presence change the one who comes near.
2051 says the iron once turned to gold never turns back; 2054 names the agent, the guru as a touchstone, and widens it to all the world he touches.
Both make the guru's path the one road that Nandi set out for salvation.

2049 makes தாள்தந்து, the giving of the feet, the true guru's single act, repeated in every line with four effects. 2384 uses the same phrase of Nandi (சீர்நந்தி தாள்தந்து), who gave his feet and then taught Vedanta and Siddhanta. Together they show the gift of the feet as Tirumular's term for initiation, preceding the teaching.

2050 says the guru set his feet on the devotee's head (சிரத்தோடு தன் பாதம்) and ended the sorrow of birth. Arunagiri asks Murugan to set his lotus feet as a crown on his head (வாரிஜபதங்கள் ... முடிபுனைந்து) and rule him with a word of teaching (போதக வாசகம்). Both treat the feet on the head as the act by which the guru takes a disciple.

2050 states as done what the song pleads for: the guru kept away the band of Yama's messengers (நமன் தூதுவர் கூட்டம்). Arunagiri pictures those messengers (நமனுடைய தூதர்) seizing and cutting him and asks Murugan, 'the guru who came to rule those who trust him', to come quickly at that hour. The pairing sets Tirumular's assurance beside the devotee's petition for it.

2052 says those moved by clamour, without knowledge, are not போதக் குரு, gurus who give understanding. 2045, in the chapter on false gurus, calls false those who have seen mantra, yoga and jnana but do not reflect or make others clear (சிந்தனை செய்யாத் தெளிவியாது). Both make the power to bring understanding the test that separates the true guru from the false.

2055 says that when the guru's presence is revealed 'the self must win itself' (தானே தனைப்பெற வேண்டும்). The Kural praises one who has wholly gained his own self (தன்னுயிர் தான் அறப்பெற்றானை), whom all beings worship. Tirumular places the same self-gaining inside the guru's presence, as the fruit of initiation rather than of tapas alone.

2060 says all is the Lord's bliss with the Lady, and that the soul's rise to the Siva-state is play (விளையாட்டே). 396 says one He and one She set to play (ஒருவன் ஒருத்தி விளையாடல்) and their play brings forth everything. 396 makes creation the couple's play; 2060 extends the same word to the soul's release.

2061 lists the Lord's acts toward the soul, ending in setting it in silence once it reaches release (வீடுற்று மோனத்துள் வைத்தலும்). 1611 says that for those to whom silence has come, release comes and the five acts come forward. 2061 makes silence the Lord's final gift; 1611 makes it the condition from which release and the five acts follow.

2064 says nectar ripened in the mandala of rubies, and those who guarded and drank it were freed from birth while the brutes (மாக்கள்) lived for the flesh. 335 sets yogis who taste the nectar of the moon (ஒண்மதி ... அமுதை) against fools who drink liquor and lose understanding. Both divide people by which drink they take, the inner nectar or the body's.

2058 says the guru, when he speaks, shows the real, the unreal and the real-unreal (சத்தும் அசத்தும் சதசத்தும்). 2065 says the Lord sets apart the same three (அசத்தொடு சத்தும் அசத்சத்து) and makes the one thing known. The same triad is assigned once to the guru and once to the Lord, which the chapter resolves in 2066 by calling the Supreme the guru.

The chapter opens with 'the lord who gives his feet is the true guru' (தலைவனே சற்குரு) and closes with 'the Supreme, if you would name him, is the guru' (பரனே குருவாம்). Both list the guru's acts on the bonds (பாசம் தணிக்கும், பசுபாசம் வாட்டலால்). Read together, the identity runs both ways: the guru is the Lord and the Lord is the guru.

source_issues: 2060: வலலார் (line 2) and செலலா (line 4) are misprints for வல்லார் and செல்லா.
2061 line 1: மீட்டுட்டி is obscure, perhaps for மீட்டு ஊட்டி.
2063 and 2065 are syntactically obscure and may be corrupt.
